set.body:
Defect: A module added to root.aggregate but not to allModules is silently skipped by compileAll while CI still runs it.

Do: Add `corpus` (crossProject JVM/JS/Native, CrossType.Pure, dependsOn(core) -- NOT features, revision 1 listed it and nothing used it) and `corpus-intake` (JVM-only project, dependsOn(corpus.jvm, core.jvm), Test / fork := true as media/pipeline/providerAgent/embedOnnx/embedBench all do). Empty, compiling.

Tests: reference-scope.sh emits corpusIntake for a corpus-intake/src change.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): remove "corpus" from allModules (build.sbt:444-486) -> compileAll must shrink. NB revision 1's mutant targeted root.aggregate and was decorative: compileAll/testAll/testJVM are built from allModules + jvmOnlyModules, not the aggregate.

Exit: compileAll green; new modules also enter CI's rootJS/rootNative link steps (CI landed at 14f95f33).

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S1, P0
set.title: intake P0: corpus + corpus-intake module skeletons, aggregated correctly
